'''The Wheelwright: The Life of Robert Jordan''' is the first chapter of {{origins}}.

The chapter gives a brief biography of [[Robert Jordan]]'s life from his birth and upbringing all the way through to his death of amyloidosis in 2007. It also briefly chronicles the completion of [[The Wheel of Time]] by [[Brandon Sanderson]].
